newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Everbright in $1.05 bln loan to fund HK Telecommunications.
newsitem.headline: China Everbright in $1.05 bln loan to fund HK Telecommunications.

text.p: Everbright Finance and Investment Co Ltd, a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Everbright Holdings Co Ltd, said it was borrowing US$1.05 billion to finance up to 70 percent of the purchase of 904,686,181 shares in Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd.

The Hongkong Telecom shares would be charged as security for the loan and China Everbright Holdings Co would unconditionally guarantee the obligations of Everbright Finance and Investment Co, China Everbright said in a statement.
It said the one-year facility would pay an all-in of 45 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate, and drawdown would be on or before June 6.

The loan arrangers are: the China Construction Bank (Hong Kong branch), China International Capital Corp, China Development Finance Co (HK), HSBC Investment Bank Asia, Goldman Sachs (Asia) Finance and Hang Seng Finance.
Lead managers are: Bank of China (Hong Kong branch), China Construction Bank (Hong Kong branch), Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corp Goldman Sachs (Asia) Finance, and Hang Seng Bank.
China Everbright agreed on May 9 to buy 7.74 percent of Hongkong Telecom from CITIC Pacific Ltd at a purchase price of HK$12.60 a share, or a total of HK$11.4 billion.
China Everbright Holdings Co is a holding company controlled by China's State Council.
It has three Hong Kong-listed arms -- China Everbright-IHD Pacific Ltd, China Everbright Technology Ltd and China Everbright International Ltd.
China Everbright-IHD Pacific said on Friday it was planning to make an announcement early next week following the suspension of trading in its shares this week.
Shares of China Everbright-IHD Pacific and China Everbright Technology have been suspended since Monday this week, and China Everbright International shares have been suspended since Tuesday.
